info.name: PARCO Fuel System API
info.description:
Tests for the PARCO Fuel System backend (server/). Run the whole collection in order (Collection Runner): each request's Tests tab checks the reply, and some save values (token, station, tank, nozzle ids) for the requests after them.

Needs: the server running (`dart run bin/server.dart` in server/) and the demo data loaded (`dart run bin/migrate.dart --seed`). A run adds test rows (an order, a staff member, a station, a signup account); `dart run bin/migrate.dart --remove-demo --seed` resets all of them.

item.name: 1. Health
item.description: Is the server up, and can it reach PostgreSQL and Redis?
